challenge.better_approach: Considered a return mark, as 8e7c used, but _return_if_marked sends a return-kind body back unacted on, before verb dispatch, so the tooth would never see its bounce. A perform mark passes through to the verb, and _bounce_to_sender then disposes of it. Changing the shim is out: it already does the right thing with a marked body.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a perform-marked undeclared verb still bounces. Measured: the 60cc proof is 2/2 with the mark, and the reply carries the mark back.
challenge.prior_art: test_a_bouncing_shim_raises_its_own_trouble.py:209 marks a bounced ask with testing_mark.PERFORM for the same reason, and 8e7c7add550f marked the probe-carry proof's poke today.
challenge.real_collision: none: ad7caca4d54c asked for marked bodies, and b3386f431ae3's disposal in the shim is what this relies on.

answers.falsifier: The tooth's live ask carries a perform mark, and the bounce answering it carries the same mark back. The tooth still passes in under 10 s. No new occurrence of the trouble after a run.
answers.from_idea: none, because this was measured, not imagined: live trouble mail-tester-has-no-verb-no-such-verb-60cc220da787 in ~/.cairn/logs/cairn/0/troubletickets/ (bin/cairn trouble live --json, 2026-11-16), 7 occurrences from sender a_bounce_answers_60cc
answers.how: In cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_bounce_answers_the_request_that_bore_it.py, tooth 2's request body becomes {testing_mark.FIELD: testing_mark.mark('60cc220da787', PERFORM)}. A red-first proof wraps the bus client, records the ask and its reply, and checks the mark goes out and comes back on the bounce.
answers.traces_to: Law 7: the trouble lane is a record of truth, and test debris there crowds out real errors. ad7caca4d54c intended every body a test sends to be marked as testing.
answers.what: The 60cc bounce proof's live ask for an undeclared verb carries a perform testing mark, so the tester's bounce disposes of its trouble instead of raising a live one.

bullets.text: The 60cc bounce proof asked the live tester unmarked, so each run raised a live trouble. It now asks with a perform mark, since a return mark would be returned before the verb and never bounce.

title: The 60cc bounce proof's live ask for an undeclared verb carries a perform testing mark, so the tester's bounce disposes
